preconditions.description: The integer k must be between 2 and 12 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == 2**k and all(0 <= a_i < 2**k for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: The array a must have exactly 2^k elements, each between 0 and 2^k - 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Fou' if not any((p_i ^ q_i) == a_i for i in range(2**k) for p_i in range(2**k) for q_i in range(2**k)) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid permutations p and q exist, output 'Fou'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('Shi') and len(p) == 2**k and len(q) == 2**k and all(p_i != p_j for i in range(2**k) for j in range(i + 1, 2**k)) and all(q_i != q_j for i in range(2**k) for j in range(i + 1, 2**k)) and all((p[i] ^ q[i]) == a[i] for i in range(2**k))
postconditions.description: If valid permutations p and q exist, output 'Shi' followed by the permutations.
